capabilities: Show letter hints over links and jump to one via the keyboard
Open hinted links in a new pane with Shift
Jump to any word using a configurable RegEx match with letter labels
Select text up to the jump target with Shift
Provide Lightspeed-style two-letter navigation in the CodeMirror 6 editor
extras: The plugin no longer ships default hotkeys, so users must assign their own to avoid clashes; Lightspeed only works in the CodeMirror 6 editor; a Known issues section exists but is empty.
motivation: The idea and original code for Lightspeed came from a contributor, @kohane27.
problem: Opening a link or moving the cursor to a distant word in a note normally requires the mouse or repeated arrow-key movement.

relations.evidence: Jump to Anywhere is a RegEx based navigation feature, similar to vim-easymotion.
Lightspeed is originally a vim plugin similar to vim-sneak or easymotion.
You can either assign a hotkey, or use it in combination with the Obsidian vimrc plugin

summary: Keyboard navigation plugin that overlays letter hints over links and words so you can jump or open them without the mouse.
